'''Nogometni klub Slavija Vevče''' ({{langx|en|Slavija Vevče Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Slavija Vevče''' or simply '''Slavija''', was a Slovenian [[association football|football]] club based in [[Vevče]]. The club was formed in 1921<ref name="founded"/> and played in the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]] in the [[1994–95 Slovenian PrvaLiga|1994–95]] season, after they replaced [[NK Svoboda|Svoboda]] before the start of the competition.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zgodovina Prve Lige: Sezona 1994/95 |url=https://snportal.si/zgodovina/zgodovina-prve-lige-sezona-1993-94-2/ |website=Slovenski nogometni portal |access-date=23 July 2020 |language=sl-SI |date=11 March 2013}}</ref> They were sponsored by local printing company SET for most of the time, therefore their first team often played under the name SET Vevče rather than Slavija. In 1996, they merged with [[ND Slovan|Slovan]] and moved to [[Kodeljevo Sports Park|Kodeljevo]] to play there as ND Slovan-Slavija for three seasons.<ref>{{cite web |title=ND Slovan Ljubljana – Soccer – Team Profile – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics – Global Sports Archive |url=https://globalsportsarchive.com/team/soccer/nd-slovan-ljubljana/22191/ |website=globalsportsarchive.com |access-date=23 July 2020}}</ref> They have won the [[Slovenian Second League]] in [[1996–97 Slovenian Second League|1996–97]],<ref>{{cite web |title=Slovenia 1996/97 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/slov97.html |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation |access-date=23 July 2020}}</ref> but were then relegated from the first and second divisions in two seasons. After 1999, Slavija was eventually left out of the club's name, playing from then onwards only as Slovan."}}
